race.title: B K Racing Long Distance Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
race.verdict: WAL BUCK'S was unlucky to bump into one on his return here last month and shades the vote over Betterforeveryone , who has plenty going for him. My Gift To You is best of the others. WAL BUCK'S (FR) BETTERFOREVERYONE MY GIFT TO YOU (IRE)
